v9-7.candidate: Saul said to his young servant who was with him, “Behold, we will go. What shall we bring the man of God? The loaves are gone from our containers, and we have nothing more of our possessions to bring the man of God.”

v10-2.candidate: When you leave me today, you will find two men near Rachel’s tombs in Benjamin’s territory, leaping greatly. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you both went to seek have been found. Behold, your father has cast aside the matter of the donkeys and has spent lavishly on account of you both, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

v10-8.candidate: Go down before Gilgal. Behold, I will come down to you to offer a whole burnt offering and peace sacrifices. Wait seven days until I come to you; then I will make known to you what you must do.”

v10-10.candidate: He came from there to the hill, and behold, a chorus of prophets was facing him. God’s Spirit leaped upon him, and he prophesied among them.

v10-11.candidate: All who had known him before saw, and behold, he was among the prophets. The people said to one another, “What has happened to Kish’s son? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
